Fetch ESA WorldCover 10 m tiles covering an AOI

fetch_landuse.Rd

Downloads ESA WorldCover 10 m tiles from AWS S3 for all 3 deg grid cells that intersect the AOI. The function optionally HEAD-checks URLs, honors local caching, and records output metadata on the input object.

Usage

fetch_landuse(
  df,
  out_dir,
  year = 2021,
  version = "v200",
  layer = "map",
  check_remote = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  progress = TRUE,
  aoi = NULL,
  wc_year = NULL,
  wc_version = NULL,
  check_exists_remote = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A data object carrying the AOI. If aoi is not supplied, the function reads attr(df, "traktr_aoi"). The AOI must be an sf polygon/multipolygon with a valid CRS.

out_dir

Directory where output GeoTIFF files are written. Will be created if it does not exist.

year

WorldCover reference year. For example, 2020 (v100) or 2021 (v200).

version

WorldCover product version string, e.g. "v100" or "v200".

layer

Product layer name. Use "map" for the 10 m land-cover classification layer.

check_remote

Logical. If TRUE, issue HTTP HEAD requests to verify remote availability before downloading.

overwrite

Logical. If FALSE (default), existing files are skipped. If TRUE, files are re-downloaded.

progress

Logical. If TRUE (default), show progress messages and a progress bar.

aoi

Optional sf polygon/multipolygon. If supplied, overrides attr(df, "traktr_aoi").

wc_year

Deprecated. Use year.

wc_version

Deprecated. Use version.

check_exists_remote

Deprecated. Use check_remote.

Value

The input df, returned invisibly, augmented with attributes describing outputs and call parameters (see Details).

Details

  • AOI handling: The AOI is validated and transformed to EPSG:4326.

  • Tiling: A regular 3 deg grid (aligned to integer multiples of 3 deg) is generated to cover the AOI bounding box. Only cells that intersect the AOI are requested. Tile codes follow the lower-left corner convention, e.g. N48E006 or S03W072.

  • Caching: Output filenames are the official WorldCover basenames, which remain stable across runs.

  • Attributes:

    • attr(df, "worldcover_tiles") stores a tibble with per-tile URL, file path, status, size, and geometry.

    • attr(df, "worldcover_aoi") stores the AOI used (WGS84).

    • attr(df, "traktr_layers")$worldcover stores the same information in a harmonized container for downstream discovery.

See also

fetch_ndvi

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df <- some_traktr_object_with_aoi()
df <- fetch_landuse(
  df,
  out_dir      = "data/worldcover",
  year         = 2021,
  version      = "v200",
  layer        = "map",
  check_remote = FALSE,
  overwrite    = FALSE,
  progress     = TRUE
)
# Inspect results table
attr(df, "traktr_layers")$worldcover$index
} # }
